The building blocks of a tableau are signed formulas sentences plus a truth value sign either Mathematical expression. true. End mathematical expression. or Mathematical expression. false. End mathematical expression. These signed formulas are arranged in a downward growing tree. Definition. Each signed formula in the tree is either an assumption which are listed at the very top of the tree or it is obtained from a signed formula above it by one of a number of rules of inference. Some rules allow the tree to branch and some only add signed formulas to the branch.
